title: Replace the hardcoded /home/daniel font path in store_screenshots_test.dart's loadFonts() with a portable source
why: loadFonts() is called from setUpAll and guards every font file with existsSync(), so on any machine other than this one developer's laptop (CI, any teammate) the path simply doesn't exist, real Roboto/MaterialIcons silently never load, and all 5 matchesGoldenFile comparisons render with fallback glyphs against the checked-in pixel-pinned PNGs (test/golden/goldens/*.png, last regenerated on this same machine). `make ci`'s `test:` target runs bare `flutter test --coverage` (no path/tag filter) and ci.yml runs `make ci` on a GitHub-hosted runner that never has this path, so this is exactly the 'platform font differences make cross-machine goldens randomly red' failure TQ-5 exists to prevent — and it defeats the file's own stated purpose (real Play Store screenshots) everywhere but one machine.
recommendation: Load fonts the same way test/flutter_test_config.dart already handles GoogleFonts (bundled asset / offline mode), or resolve the Material fonts directory dynamically (e.g. via the Flutter SDK root the test runner already knows about) instead of a hardcoded absolute path tied to one developer's home directory and FVM install.
acceptance_criteria: flutter test test/golden/store_screenshots_test.dart passes on a fresh checkout/container with no /home/daniel path present
Rule-0 grep in the audit/CI script rejects hardcoded /home/<user>/ (or any non-repo-relative) absolute paths under test/
